findings.description: Removing the already_bracketed check means optional parameters whose metavar already starts and ends with brackets get wrapped in brackets a second time, producing malformed usage text such as [[a|b]].
findings.rationale: Trigger: an optional click.Option with a Choice type, whose get_metavar returns a bracketed string like [a|b], or a user-supplied metavar such as [VALUE]. Mechanism: the condition is now only not self.required, so f"[{var}]" wraps the already-bracketed var again. Impact: --help and usage output show doubled brackets, a visible regression from the previous behavior that this check existed to prevent.
